data.title: 克莱尔 · 剑斗盛会中央的高举剑礼
data.description: 全王都瞩目的剑术锦标赛石砌擂台中央，看台人山人海彩旗翻飞。克莱尔身穿首席骑士大衣高高扬起长剑向全场致敬，英姿飒爽，气势压人。
data.location: massive medieval stone tournament arena surrounded by cheering multi-tiered crowds and banners
data.action: standing victorious on stone arena stage, raising rapier triumphantly overhead, coat flaring in the breeze, proud beaming martial grin
data.lighting: 竞技场上方烈日直射与漫天彩带反光
data.promptProse: Claire stands victorious at the center of a roaring tournament arena, raising her sword high with a proud, commanding smile.
data.animaCaption: Arena banners flutter in the sunlit breeze as she salutes the roaring crowd.
